how: Verified in romlab (`.build/bn4-navis/`, not kept): GutsMan V1 alone against MegaMan (enemy 132 at (5, 1), MegaMan's HP held) ran CurAction 6 and 7 in turn (MegaMan's 67, a step of about 60 frames), 10 (MegaMan's 70, a machine gun's burst, frames 398-481 and 849-922 of the fight) and 8 (68, a dash, at 1237); his AI data side 1's (`0x02035BE0`), its +0x64 and +0x65 the decision's sub-states (0 and 8; 0, 4 and 12 seen) and +0x70 and +0x71 the attack's (0, 4, 8; 0, 4).
